templates.datapack.init:
scoreboard objectives add mcs_math dummy "Minecraft-Script Math"
scoreboard objectives add mcs_click {{clickScoreboardCriterion}} "Minecraft-Script Click"

function {{datapack_id}}:user_functions/init
templates.datapack.main:
execute as @a at @s if score @s mcs_click matches 1.. run function {{datapack_id}}:clickable_items/check

function {{datapack_id}}:user_functions/main
templates.datapack.kill:
function {{datapack_id}}:user_functions/kill

scoreboard objectives remove mcs_math
scoreboard objectives remove mcs_click
data remove storage mcs_click id

datapack disable "file/{{datapackName}}"
templates.literal.set_to_current: data modify storage {{destStorage}} current set from storage {{storage}} {{nbt}}
templates.literal.list.element: data modify storage {{storage}} {{nbt}}.{{index}} set from storage {{srcStorage}} current
templates.variable.declare: data modify storage {{ownerStorage}} variable.{{name}} set from storage {{valueStorage}} {{valueNbt}}
templates.variable.assign: data modify storage {{ownerStorage}} variable.{{name}} set from storage {{valueStorage}} {{valueNbt}}
templates.control.if.branch:
execute store result score .out mcs_math run data get storage {{exprStorage}} {{exprNbt}} 1
data modify storage {{branchStorage}} variable set from storage {{parentStorage}} variable
execute if score .out mcs_math matches 1 run function {{datapack_id}}:{{branchPath}}
execute if score .out mcs_math matches 1 run return 0
templates.control.for.init:
scoreboard players set .loop_iter_{{loopId}} mcs_math 0
execute store result score .loop_end_{{loopId}} mcs_math run data get storage {{iterableStorage}} {{iterableNbt}}.length 1
function {{datapack_id}}:{{loopPath}}
scoreboard players reset .loop_iter_{{loopId}} mcs_math
scoreboard players reset .loop_end_{{loopId}} mcs_math
templates.control.for.macro: $data modify storage {{loopStorage}} variable.{{elementName}} set from storage {{iterableStorage}} {{iterableNbt}}.$(index)
templates.control.for.body_setup:
execute store result storage {{loopStorage}} current.index int 1 run scoreboard players get .loop_iter_{{loopId}} mcs_math
function {{datapack_id}}:{{macroPath}} with storage {{loopStorage}} current
templates.control.for.loop_end:
scoreboard players add .loop_iter_{{loopId}} mcs_math 1
execute if score .loop_iter_{{loopId}} mcs_math < .loop_end_{{loopId}} mcs_math run function {{datapack_id}}:{{loopPath}}
templates.control.while.tail:
execute store result score .out mcs_math run data get storage {{condStorage}} {{condNbt}} 1
execute if score .out mcs_math matches 1 run function {{datapack_id}}:{{loopPath}}
templates.control.async_while.condition:
execute store result score .out mcs_math run data get storage {{condStorage}} {{condNbt}} 1
execute if score .out mcs_math matches 1 run function {{datapack_id}}:{{loopPath}}
templates.control.code_block:
data modify storage {{childStorage}} variable set from storage {{parentStorage}} variable
function {{datapack_id}}:{{blockPath}}
templates.control.entity_selector:
data modify storage {{childStorage}} variable set from storage {{parentStorage}} variable
execute as {{selector}} at @s run function {{datapack_id}}:{{childPath}}
templates.function.call.param:
data modify storage {{localStorage}} current set from storage {{argStorage}} {{argNbt}}
data modify storage {{localStorage}} variable.{{paramName}} set from storage {{localStorage}} current
templates.builtin.append.setup:
data modify storage {{ctxStorage}} current set value {}
data modify storage {{ctxStorage}} current.index set from storage {{listStorage}} {{listNbt}}.length
function {{datapack_id}}:{{macroPath}} with storage {{ctxStorage}} current
execute store result score .temp mcs_math run data get storage {{listStorage}} {{listNbt}}.length
scoreboard players set .1 mcs_math 1
scoreboard players operation .temp mcs_math += .1 mcs_math
execute store result storage {{listStorage}} {{listNbt}}.length int 1 run scoreboard players get .temp mcs_math
scoreboard players reset .1 mcs_math
templates.builtin.range.cleanup:
scoreboard players reset .range_current_{{scoreboardId}} mcs_math
scoreboard players reset .range_max_{{scoreboardId}} mcs_math
templates.builtin.range.recursive:
data modify storage {{recursiveStorage}} current set value {}
execute store result storage {{recursiveStorage}} current.index int 1 run scoreboard players get .range_current_{{scoreboardId}} mcs_math
function {{datapack_id}}:{{setIndexPath}} with storage {{recursiveStorage}} current
scoreboard players set .1 mcs_math 1
scoreboard players operation .range_current_{{scoreboardId}} mcs_math += .1 mcs_math
scoreboard players reset .1 mcs_math
execute unless score .range_current_{{scoreboardId}} mcs_math >= .range_max_{{scoreboardId}} mcs_math run function {{datapack_id}}:{{recursivePath}}

pack.description: This datapack was generated using Minecraft-Script

breaking_changes._note: User-written NBT/item syntax inside .mcs files is not configured here.

1.21.summary: Datapack directories use singular names (functions→function, tags/functions→tags/function, etc.)

1.21.9.summary: pack.mcmeta uses min_format/max_format instead of pack_format alone

1.20.2.summary: Entity effect NBT renames — affects command() strings in user .mcs only
